The basic flow feels quick, and newest-first is the order I’d expect.

Leaving the title blank should fill in the page’s actual title, though—not just the website name. I’d also expect it to bring in the page description, icon, and preview image when available, while still letting me change the title and description.

One important correction: if I save the same address again, I don’t want a duplicate. It should show me the existing bookmark and let me edit it.
